claims.evidence: No stitching sample or working video shown.
No country-of-origin marking visible on the machine body in photo 0.

claims.evidence: No accessories, manual, or box shown in photo 0.

risks.risk: Motor, pedal, and stand/table may not be included, which are essential for an industrial machine to function and significantly affect value.
risks.proof: A full photo showing the machine mounted with motor, pedal, and belt attached, plus the complete table/stand.
risks.if_unproven: priced as head-only, motor/stand not included

risks.risk: Mechanical condition and actual stitch quality cannot be confirmed; rust speckling visible may indicate age, storage issues, or neglect.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running and sewing a stitch sample on fabric.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needing servicing

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch between seller's text claim ('Ambro Brother') and actual visible branding ('AIG BROTHER') raises doubt about authenticity or seller's attentiveness to the listing.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the brand/model plate and any serial number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic/unbranded industrial machine, not a premium-named brand

risks.risk: Claimed accessories and manual cannot be seen, so completeness of the sale bundle is unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of the accessories, manual, and any extra parts laid out together with the machine.
risks.if_unproven: priced as machine only, no accessories

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the brand/model plate and serial number.
Photo or video showing the motor, pedal, belt, and full table/stand attached.
A short video of the machine running and producing a stitch on fabric.
Photo of included accessories and the original manual, if present.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by visible branding as an industrial 'AIG BROTHER' sewing machine head, but functionality, completeness (motor/stand/accessories), and the seller's claims are all unverified, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-working head-only unit pending proof.
